arxiv-1811-07636.title: Understanding the neutrino mass constraints achievable by combining CMB lensing and spectroscopic galaxy surveys
arxiv-1811-07636.creator: Aoife Boyle
arxiv-1811-07636.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Aoife Boyle. We perform a thorough examination of the neutrino mass ( M ν M_{\nu} ) constraints achievable by combining future spectroscopic galaxy surveys with cosmic microwave background (CMB) experiments, focusing on the contribution of CMB lensing and galaxy-CMB lensing. CMB lensing can help by breaking the M ν M_{\nu} -curvature degeneracy when combined with baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO)-only measurements, but we demonstrate this combination wastes a great deal of constraining power, as the broadband shape of the power spectrum contributes significantly to constraints.

arxiv-2108-09045.title: Connecting solar flare hard X-ray spectra to in situ electron spectra
arxiv-2108-09045.creator: N. Dresing, A. Warmuth, F. Effenberger, K.-L. Klein, S. Musset, L. Glesener, M. Brüdern
arxiv-2108-09045.description: Abstract Aims. We aim to constrain the acceleration, injection, and transport processes of flare-accelerated energetic electrons by comparing their characteristics at the Sun with those injected into interplanetary space. Methods. We have identified 17 energetic electron events well-observed with the SEPT instrument aboard STEREO which show a clear association with a hard X-ray (HXR) flare observed with the RHESSI spacecraft.

arxiv-2304-03351.title: Entity Graphs for Exploring Online Discourse
arxiv-2304-03351.creator: Nicholas Botzer, Tim Weninger
arxiv-2304-03351.description: Abstract Vast amounts of human communication occurs online. These digital traces of natural human communication along with recent advances in natural language processing technology provide for computational analysis of these discussions. In the study of social networks the typical perspective is to view users as nodes and concepts as flowing through and among the user-nodes within the social network.

arxiv-2309-15865.title: The p 0 − p_{0}- Laplace “Signature” for Quasilinear Inverse Problems
arxiv-2309-15865.creator: Antonio Corbo Esposito 1 , Luisa Faella 1 , Gianpaolo Piscitelli 2 , Vincenzo Mottola 1 , Ravi Prakash 3 , Antonello Tamburrino 1,4
arxiv-2309-15865.description: Abstract . This paper refers to an imaging problem in the presence of nonlinear materials. Specifically, the problem we address falls within the framework of Electrical Resistance Tomography and involves two different materials, one or both of which are nonlinear. Tomography with nonlinear materials in the early stages of developments, although breakthroughs are expected in the not-too-distant future.

arxiv-2310-00335.title: Anomaly Detection in Power Generation Plants with Generative Adversarial Networks Thanks:
arxiv-2310-00335.creator: Marcellin Atemkeng, Toheeb A. Jimoh
arxiv-2310-00335.description: Abstract Anomaly detection is a critical task that involves the identification of data points that deviate from a predefined pattern, useful for fraud detection and related activities. Various techniques are employed for anomaly detection, but recent research indicates that deep learning methods, with their ability to discern intricate data patterns, are well-suited for this task.

arxiv-2404-19131.title: Capillary processes in extraterrestrial contexts
arxiv-2404-19131.creator: Daniel Cordier, Gérard Liger-Belair, David A. Bonhommeau, Thomas Séon, Thomas Appéré, Nathalie Carrasco
arxiv-2404-19131.description: Abstract The Earth is no longer the only known celestial body containing one or more liquid phases. The Cassini spacecraft has discovered seas of hydrocarbons at the surface of Titan, while a series of corroborating evidences argue in favour of the existence of an aqueous ocean beneath the icy crust of several moons.

arxiv-2407-00624.title: Evidence for particle acceleration approaching PeV energies in the W51 complex
arxiv-2407-00624.creator: LHAASO Collaboration
arxiv-2407-00624.description: Abstract The γ \gamma -ray emission from the W51 complex is widely acknowledged to be attributed to the interaction between the cosmic rays (CRs) accelerated by the shock of supernova remnant (SNR) W51C and the dense molecular clouds in the adjacent star-forming region, W51B. However, the maximum acceleration capability of W51C for CRs remains elusive.

arxiv-2412-16940.title: The Island of Inversion at N=40
arxiv-2412-16940.creator: Martha Liliana Cortés
arxiv-2412-16940.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Martha Liliana Cortés. Our understanding of the structure of atomic nuclei largely derives from the nuclear shell model, which has proven widely successful. Further test to our interpretation of the nuclear properties is provided by the study of shell evolution. Increasing experimental information has shown that the nuclear energy shells change when going towards the most exotic nuclei, in turn making some shell closures disappear while others arise.

arxiv-2501-01813.title: Eliciting Understandable Architectonic Gestures for Robotic Furniture through Co-Design Improvisation
arxiv-2501-01813.creator: Alex Binh Vinh Duc Nguyen, Jan Leusmann, Sven Mayer, Andrew Vande Moere
arxiv-2501-01813.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alex Binh Vinh Duc Nguyen, Jan Leusmann, Sven Mayer, Andrew Vande Moere. The vision of adaptive architecture proposes that robotic technologies could enable interior spaces to physically transform in a bidirectional interaction with occupants. Yet, it is still unknown how this interaction could unfold in an understandable way. Inspired by HRI studies where robotic furniture gestured intents to occupants by deliberately positioning or moving in space, we hypothesise that adaptive architecture could also convey intents through gestures performed by a mobile robotic partition.

arxiv-2505-19052.title: Probing Time-Varying Dark Energy with DESI: The Crucial Role of Precision Matter Density ( Ω m0 \Omega_{\rm{m}0} ) Measurements
arxiv-2505-19052.creator: Seokcheon Lee
arxiv-2505-19052.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seokcheon Lee. Accurate measurements of fundamental cosmological parameters, especially the Hubble constant ( H 0 H_{0} ) and present-day matter density ( Ω m0 \Omega_{\rm{m}0} ), are crucial for constraining dark energy (DE) evolution. We analyze the sensitivities of cosmological observables ( H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) , D L ​ ( z ) D_{L}(z) , E G \text{E}_{\text{G}} ) to Ω m0 \Omega_{\rm{m}0} , ω 0 \omega_{0} , and ω a \omega_{a} under different parametrizations.

arxiv-2508-15985.title: Panoptic Segmentation of Environmental UAV Images : Litter Beach
arxiv-2508-15985.creator: Ousmane YOUME, Jean Marie Dembele, Eugene C. Ezin, Christophe Cambier
arxiv-2508-15985.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNN) have been used efficiently in several fields, including environmental challenges. In fact, CNN can help with the monitoring of marine litter, which has become a worldwide problem. UAVs have higher resolution and are more adaptable in local areas than satellite images, making it easier to find and count trash.

arxiv-2512-09369.title: Are Hypervectors Enough? Single-Call LLM Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2512-09369.creator: Yezi Liu, William Youngwoo Chung, Hanning Chen, Mohsen Imani
arxiv-2512-09369.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled strong reasoning over both structured and unstructured knowledge. When grounded on knowledge graphs (KGs), however, prevailing pipelines rely on heavy neural encoders to embed and score symbolic paths or on repeated LLM calls to rank candidates, leading to high latency, GPU cost, and opaque decisions that hinder faithful, scalable deployment.

pmc-10544574.creator: Lei Duan, Yu Ding, Gao-hui Sun, Yun-tao Li

pmc-10612147.title: The future of FemTech ethics & privacy – a global perspective
pmc-10612147.creator: Najd Alfawzan, Markus Christen
pmc-10612147.description: We discuss the concept of women’s empowerment in FemTech, considering cultural and legal differences, ethical concerns, and legal consequences. We claim that it is crucial to prioritize privacy, a fundamental right, especially in the case of changes in laws related to women’s health, such as Roe v. Wade in the US.Keywords: FemTech, Privacy, Ethics, Women’s Health, Digital Health, Roe v.

pmc-12582484.title: Using a World Health Assembly simulation to explore undergraduate students’ perceptions and confidence in analyzing complex global health challenges: A mixed-methods evaluation
pmc-12582484.creator: Ahmad Firas Khalid, Megan A. George, Clarissa Eggen, Aaranee Sritharan, Faiza Wali, A. M. Viens
pmc-12582484.description: Traditional didactic teaching approaches fall short of adequately supporting diverse student learning styles. Complementing didactic teaching approaches with simulation-based experiential learning can bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application. However, few studies have rigorously examined the outcomes of this approach in global health education and training.

pmc-12651856.title: Modified CAMBRA Protocol for Caries Risk Assessment in Children Aged 6 to 14 Years
pmc-12651856.creator: Esther Pérez de Mora, Ángel Luis Formoso-Veloso, Marcela Arenas-González, Asunción Mendoza-Mendoza, David Ribas-Pérez, Christos Rahiotis
pmc-12651856.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to propose a modified CAMBRA protocol for caries risk analysis in a pediatric population, adapted to their needs and habits. Methods: A descriptive and analytical observational study was conducted after obtaining approval from the Ethics Committee. Caries risk was determined using the CAMBRA Questionnaire and the modified University of Seville Questionnaire (CAMBRA-OP Questionnaire).

pmc-13413062.creator: Khaldoon Alhusari, Salam Dhou

uslaw-usc-t15-s3605.title: 15 U.S.C. § 3605 — Notice of conversion and opportunity to purchase; responsibility of State and local governments
uslaw-usc-t15-s3605.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s3605.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 62 (Condominium And Cooperative Conversion Protection And Abuse Relief). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the sense of the Congress that, when multifamily rental housing projects are converted to condominium or cooperative use, tenants in those projects are entitled to adequate notice of the pending conversion and to receive the first opportunity.
